thread:
ivy: Heads-up I opened a docs PR to consolidate several small model-card fixes (CLI examples, SDK snippets, bench links). Wanted to run the list by folks before I push more.

noah: Thanks. Major items we should standardize: use `rw models` (plural) for all CLI blocks, switch SDK examples to `client.text.generate` or `client.embeddings.create` patterns, and point all bench links to bench.redwood.ai JSON endpoints.

sasha: Also noticed a pattern where some cards list "quantized: CPU" generically. Infra asked we add precise notes: either "quantized: GPU supported" or "CPU quant requires >=16GB/32GB" with the exact value per model. We should avoid the ambiguous blanket statement.

ivy: Agreed. My PR 1436 currently updates three cards (Aster-7b, Kestrel-13b, Meridian-2b) to follow those rules. I also replaced old S3 CSV links with the new JSON URLs.

ophelia: Quick nit: sample SDK outputs need to be updated from `resp[0].text` to `resp.output_text` and `resp[0].embedding` to `resp.data[0].embedding`. Make sure the examples show the modern accessors.

ci-bot: CI: docs build failed - linkcheck: /docs/catalog/kestrel-13b#benchmarks -> 404 (old CSV link)

ivy: Pushed patch replacing the Kestrel CSV with https://bench.redwood.ai/kestrel-13b/v1/report.json and updated the CLI and SDK snippets.

noah: I also added a short parenthetical in the Aster-7b limits row: "(8k theoretical, 6k recommended with default KV cache)" to clarify practical limits.

sasha: For Meridian-2b the compatibility table listed multi-gpu as "beta". Infra prefers "experimental" and a link to the new multi-gpu guide. I added that link and status.

ci-bot: CI: re-run queued.

ci-bot: CI: build passed. deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-1436--docs.redwood.ai/catalog/summary

ivy: Preview looks clean. The bench anchors resolve and SDK snippets render in the playground. I'll merge shortly and add a one-line changelog entry: "docs: migrate model-card CLI/SDK examples + bench links; clarify quant and multi-gpu notes."

ophelia: LGTM. Post-merge I'll open a tiny follow-up to sweep any remaining `model_id` occurrences in examples/ across the repo.

noah: Thanks team for quick turnaround.
